column3: “Full of wrath” renders “master of wrath”; “wrath” is supplied as what He reserves.
“The guilty” is supplied as the object of not leaving unpunished.
“Nineveh” replaces “her place”; the darkness that pursues His enemies is interpreted as their destination.
The Hebrew compares them with drunkards drunk on their drink, rather than with a drunkard’s drink being consumed.
“Allied” interprets being whole; “O Judah” is supplied, and the singular passing away becomes plural.
“Their” replaces “his”; “neck” makes the location of the yoke explicit.
“O Nineveh” is supplied; descendants make the sowing from the name explicit.
The singular wicked person is rendered in the plural.
